findings.detail: Cost currency was stored as U_USD although the schedule presents Cost and Fair Value as dollar-denominated columns.

rationale: FX03 flagged cost_currency values of U_USD for the 16 BDC holding rows. The raw schedule of investments labels Cost and Fair Value columns and shows dollar signs for the valuation cells, including the first position and total investment portfolio. The source therefore supports USD as the valuation currency; storing U_USD instead of normalized USD is a real unit extraction/normalization defect.
